Hi Jared — thanks for the note and the PO. We're ready to get set up. Attached is our standard vendor packet and a current W-9. Quick answers up front:
- Redwood can accept split invoicing across legal entities with a single PO as long as each invoice includes the receiving legal entity name and tax ID.
- Please include the PO number in the invoice subject line and on the first page of the PDF. We recommend PDF/A where possible; the AP system prefers a single-page cover + line-item detail.
- Standard terms: NET30 unless otherwise negotiated; if Cascade requires earlier payment, we can discuss early-pay options.

What we need from you to complete enrollment:
1) Completed Cascade AP vendor form (we've included a fillable packet for your convenience).
2) Official remit-to instructions (bank name, account number, beneficiary name) OR confirmation that you will accept electronic transfer to the account on file.
3) Billing contact for disputes and one email for invoice submission (we'll add it to our supplier record).

I'll loop Marissa for the final activation and Karthik for any tax/PO header compliance checks. If you can send the completed packet and W-9 back to this thread, we'll request vendor activation within our AP system and confirm the invoice submission endpoint.

Attachments: Redwood_Vendor_Packet_Fillable.pdf (application/pdf), W9_Redwood.pdf (application/pdf)

Best,
Rachel Kim
